text:
sam: Quick find from the onboarding audit: a few Ruby quickstart snippets are still showing `ENV['REDWOOD_TOKEN'] = 'YOUR_TOKEN'` and then inserting it into headers. Also the ruby example doesn't show how to configure retries/backoff, which differs from JS/py defaults.

leah: thanks for flagging. ruby wasn't auto-updated when we renamed the env var. where are the files?

sam: quickstarts/ruby-quickstart/README.md, examples/ruby-widget/README.md, and an old tutorial in docs/tutorials/server-side-ruby.md.

ruben: Oof. Two problems: 1) inconsistent env var naming (REDWOOD_TOKEN vs REDWOOD_API_KEY) will confuse users; 2) Ruby example uses a naive `Net::HTTP` loop with no jitter/backoff. People will copy that into production.

zoe: Agreed. We should standardize to REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere and show the language-specific SDK constructor where we have it. For Ruby, show either `client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])` or a safety helper that reads the env and raises a clear error.

sam: Also call out retries: JS/Python SDKs have default exponential backoff; Ruby shim currently doesn't. Add a short snippet: `client.configure(retries: 3, backoff: :exponential)` (or show the nearest Ruby API) and a comment: "Don't implement naive retry loops; use client options."

leah: I'll open a docs PR to: replace REDWOOD_TOKEN -> REDWOOD_API_KEY, swap inline-key examples to env + SDK constructor, and add a tiny retry section. I'll also update the template for Ruby snippets in infra/docs-templates.

ruben: Can we add a docs CI job `no-inline-keys` that greps for YOUR_TOKEN/REPLACE_ME/INSERT_KEY and fails? And another test `sdk-parity-check` that renders all quickstarts and asserts they reference the language-appropriate client initialization (e.g., `Redwood::Client`, `RedwoodClient`, etc.).

ci-bot: proposed checks: `no-inline-keys` (grep), `sdk-parity-check` (render + assert), `no-naive-retries` (grep for naive retry patterns like `while true` with immediate retry). Want me to add them to docs GH actions?

zoe: yes please. Also update CONTRIBUTING.md with a short heading "Code example hygiene": env vars, SDK constructors, retries/backoff, and don't paste secrets.

sam: I'll make the grep script language-agnostic and include patterns for Ruby/Go/TS/Python. Also add a lint to catch old import names (e.g., `require "redwood"` -> `require "@redwood/inference"` or the correct gem name).

doc-bot: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1288 
branch: fix/ruby-samples-auth-and-retries. Preview: https://deploy.preview/1288

leah: Updating infra/docs-templates now to emit SDK-first Ruby snippets and include notes on setting REDWOOD_API_KEY in mac/linux and PowerShell. I'll also include a short code comment showing `require "dotenv"` and recommend direnv/.env.local.

ruben: After merge, let's run the new `sdk-parity-check` across examples/ and external repos (widget, demos). I'll open follow-ups for any stray quickstarts.

ci-bot: `no-inline-keys` job ran on branch and failed: matches in docs/tutorials/server-side-ruby.md (old cached snippet).

leah: forcing a regen of that snippet and pushing a fix.

doc-bot: CI passing after fix; PR merged. 11 files changed.

sam: thanks team. small change but reduces onboarding friction a lot. I'll run the repo sweep tomorrow and open issues for any external repos that still have inline tokens. :thumbsup:
